name: concurrent
workload: PHASE_16_PLAN.md section 5.1's concurrent-financial profile (P16-TSK-008, E38): many clients on few accounts - every transfer between one pair of customers, one way and back by turns, every checkout from every customer to the one merchant, every top-up through the one card clearing - at the engineering workload (E30's step 3, 0.3906 of the target's peak) for 15 minutes, then the target's burst (W2: three times its peak for 60 s) twice, each followed by the engineering workload; the burst is past kind's break (E30), so this profile runs past the break by design and records the iterations it drops

operations.name: transfer
operations.from: the target's peak: 100,000 transfers a day over 36,000 s (W1 x W3), every one between the same two customers (transferPair)

operations.name: checkout
operations.from: the target's peak: 200,000 card or checkout payments a day over 36,000 s (W1 x W3), every one to the fixture's one merchant

operations.name: topup
operations.from: the target's peak: 40,000 top-ups and withdrawals a day over 36,000 s, the withdrawals folded into card top-ups (R2), all through the one card clearing

operations.name: read
operations.reason: the concurrent-financial profile drives the money movements on few accounts alone, so each row's waits are the movements' own; a balance read takes no row lock (it reads the projection, ADR-0041) and belongs to the mix, which E29 and E30 drive

operations.name: signin
operations.reason: the concurrent-financial profile drives the money movements on few accounts alone; a sign-in moves no money and locks no financial row, and belongs to the mix, which E29 and E30 drive

operations.name: merchant
operations.reason: the concurrent-financial profile drives the money movements on few accounts alone; the merchant API's payable read folds the merchant's whole history and saturates the database's CPU by itself (E30, ADR-0133), which would hide the rows' waits behind it

operations.name: callbacks
operations.from: two per captured card payment (W4), sent by Rehearsal.java load-callbacks, provider-driven

operations.name: settlement
operations.from: one PSP settlement file of the run's captures at mid-run, uploaded and attested through the operator edge, reconciled during the load (W5 at this scale)

operations.name: bnpl
operations.reason: a BNPL purchase rests on a credit approval, and on kind none is possible, automatic or by a person: every credit policy's exposure rule reads the bureau's total balance, no kind deployment can configure a bureau (the application refuses one until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved question 13 is answered), so the exposure is unassessed and the policy's fallback declines or refers (INV-CRD-10), and a person's approval of a referral is refused while it is (credit.ExposureUnassessable, INV-CRD-09); no test-only bureau is built for kind in Phase 16 (the owner, 2026-11-13), so it waits on question 13; its instalments need its agreements; so the capital row (LENDING_CAPITAL, L6) and BNPL_MERCHANT_FEE_INCOME are not driven here

operations.name: lending
operations.reason: a repayment needs a disbursed loan, and a loan rests on a credit approval, and on kind none is possible, automatic or by a person: every credit policy's exposure rule reads the bureau's total balance, no kind deployment can configure a bureau (the application refuses one until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved question 13 is answered), so the exposure is unassessed and the policy's fallback declines or refers (INV-CRD-10), and a person's approval of a referral is refused while it is (credit.ExposureUnassessable, INV-CRD-09); no test-only bureau is built for kind in Phase 16 (the owner, 2026-11-13), so it waits on question 13; so many repayments of one loan are not driven here

operations.name: credit
operations.reason: a decision reads the bureau and financial data, neither configurable on kind (the application refuses either until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved questions 13 and 14 are answered), so every decision there is the fail-safe path, waiting its 30-minute collection window and referring (INV-CRD-10), which is E20's subject and not the target's decision; a decision with data waits on question 13, no test-only bureau being built for kind in Phase 16 (the owner, 2026-11-13)
